title: Internet Memes
description: Test your knowledge of iconic internet memes!

questions.question: What is the name of the cat from the 'I Can Has Cheezburger?' meme?
questions.explanation: The wide-mouthed grey cat from the 2007 LOLcat meme is known as Happy Cat or 'Cheezburger Cat'.

questions.question: What was the real name of Grumpy Cat?
questions.explanation: Grumpy Cat's real name was Tardar Sauce. She passed away in 2019.

questions.question: Rickrolling involves tricking someone into watching Rick Astley's 'Never Gonna Give You Up'.
questions.explanation: The classic bait-and-switch meme dates back to 2007 on 4chan.

questions.question: What is the green frog meme called?
questions.explanation: Pepe the Frog was created by Matt Furie in his comic 'Boy's Club' in 2005.

questions.question: What does 'TFW' stand for in meme culture?
questions.explanation: TFW means 'That Feeling When' — commonly paired with the Wojak face.

questions.question: The 'Distracted Boyfriend' meme is a stock photo by Antonio Guillem.
questions.explanation: The viral image was originally a stock photo by Spanish photographer Antonio Guillem in 2015.

questions.question: Which Shiba Inu became the face of the 'Doge' meme?
questions.explanation: Kabosu, a rescued Shiba Inu from Japan, became the iconic Doge meme. She passed away in 2024.

questions.question: What is the catchphrase associated with the 'It's Over 9000!' meme?

options.text: What does the scouter say about his power level?

questions.explanation: The line comes from the Dragon Ball Z dub where Vegeta exclaims 'It's over 9000!' about Goku's power level.

questions.question: The 'Harambe' meme refers to a gorilla shot at the Cincinnati Zoo in 2016.
questions.explanation: Harambe was shot to protect a child who fell into his enclosure, sparking massive internet memes.

questions.question: Who is the 'Side Eye Chloe' meme based on?

options.text: A young girl reacting to news she was going to Disneyland

questions.explanation: The viral image was 2-year-old Chloe Clem reacting to surprise news of a Disneyland trip in 2013.

questions.question: What animal is featured in the 'Doge' meme?
questions.explanation: Doge uses a Shiba Inu — Japanese dog breed — paired with multicolor Comic Sans text.

questions.question: The phrase 'All your base are belong to us' originated from a poorly translated video game.
questions.explanation: The phrase is from the 1989 Sega Mega Drive game 'Zero Wing'. The bad English translation went viral in the early 2000s.

questions.question: What does 'Stonks' typically refer to in meme culture?

options.text: A misspelled version of 'stocks' depicting financial gains

questions.explanation: Stonks is an intentionally misspelled 'stocks', usually paired with the Meme Man image and upward arrows.

questions.question: Which meme features a galaxy-brained man with expanding head?
questions.explanation: The Expanding Brain (Galaxy Brain) meme depicts increasingly 'enlightened' ideas with brighter brains.

questions.question: Bernie Sanders' inauguration mittens became a major meme in 2021.
questions.explanation: A photo of Bernie sitting in mittens at Biden's 2021 inauguration spawned countless Photoshop memes.
